snippet.title: Cozy Farm Life Simulator - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Build your own little farm from the ground up.
Plant crops, raise animals, hatch helpful pets, discover rare mutations, and expand your farm at your own pace.

Cozy Farm Life Simulator launches on PS5 - August 27.
